doc_id.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source file

source_uri.description: URL or local path of the source

source_version.description: Free-text version identifier, e.g. 'consolidated as of 2026-03-01'

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source file (same as doc_id)

converter.description: Tool name and version used for conversion

doc_type.description: Document type: generic, legal_code, web_page, etc.

supersedes.description: doc_id of the prior version this document supersedes

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 date when this version was superseded; null = currently valid

project.description: Project slug (Qdrant collection name) this document belongs to

meta_author.description: Article author(s) extracted from HTML metadata (article doc_type only)

meta_published_date.description: Article publication date extracted from HTML metadata (article doc_type only)

meta_publication_venue.description: News outlet or site name extracted from HTML metadata (article doc_type only)
